'''R2-M3''' was an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] used to compensate for the ''[[One Liner]]''{{'s}} lack of a [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]]. He was programmed with the location of [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Soron Hegerty]] on [[Jatee]], and led [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agents to the doctor to assist with the evacuation of the [[Ssither]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="EJ" />
